title: Ada and the Garden
author: Silas Joubert
blurb: Lena Nakamura, a debt-bound temple scribe, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
